subject: general
question: On simple interest, a certain sum of money amounts to ₹1,250 in 2 years and to ₹2,000 in 5 years. Find the rate of interest per annum (rounded off to two places of decimal).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interest for 3 years (5 − 2) = ₹2,000 − ₹1,250 = ₹750

Interest for 1 year = ₹750 ÷ 3 = ₹250

Principal (P) = Amount after 2 years − Interest for 2 years = ₹1,250 − (2 × ₹250) = ₹750

Rate % = (Interest per year ÷ Principal) × 100 = (250 ÷ 750) × 100 = 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa2189579fc94a7305fe408f157ed9efa6346fe941425f586d7864ca0068730b.png] 

**Given:** Amount (A₁) = ₹1,250 at T₁ = 2 years; Amount (A₂) = ₹2,000 at T₂ = 5 years.

**Formula:** Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100; Amount = P + SI

⇒ Interest for 3 years = A₂ − A₁ = 2,000 − 1,250 = ₹750

⇒ Simple Interest for 1 year = 750 ÷ 3 = ₹250

⇒ Simple Interest for 2 years = 250 × 2 = ₹500

⇒ Principal (P) = A₁ − SI for 2 years = 1,250 − 500 = ₹750

⇒ Rate (R) = (SI₁yᵣ × 100) ÷ P = (250 × 100) ÷ 750

⇒ Rate (R) = 100 ÷ 3 = 33.333...%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Constant Property

In **Simple Interest**, the interest earned remains the same every year because it is always calculated on the original **Principal**.

Rate of Interest Formula

The annual rate of interest can be calculated as R = (SI for 1 year ÷ Principal) × 100. This is the standard **unitary method** approach.

Relation between Amount and Time

Since Interest is linear, the difference in amounts for two different time periods gives the **Simple Interest** for the difference in those time periods.
